cases.rationale: A real hand with red fingernails holds scissors with paired blades, a pivot and handle loops. The bird silhouettes are paper cutouts against a printed water-and-sky background, so they are not actual birds; there is no identifiable flying-kite assembly. I considered all 75 definitions over the whole original crop; the remaining categories have no identifiable actual object here. No unresolved category ambiguity.

Several actual people are visible. The foreground man holds a white flying disc by its rim in a disc-handling posture; its broad recessed disc face and rolled rim support frisbee identity. Clothing and wristbands do not identify any bag or tie. I considered every one of the 75 definitions; no other category object is visible and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

A woman sits on a long slatted bench with a shared seat and back, identifying person and bench rather than a single-person chair or upholstered couch. The dense shrubs behind it have no visible pots. I considered all 75 definitions across the entire original crop; none of the other defined objects is identifiable. No unresolved category ambiguity.

The actual animal has the massive backward-curled horns, face and body of a bighorn sheep/ram. It is not cattle, a horse or a bear. Behind it are an identifiable passenger-car body, door and wheel. The short wooden bollard in front is not a hydrant. I considered every one of the 75 definitions and found no other identifiable category object. No unresolved category ambiguity.

Three upright beach boards occupy most of the crop; one has foot straps and the wooden boards have short, broad pointed forms. Surfboard is unclear because the crop does not resolve their identity against skimboard/bodyboard-like beach boards. An actual folding beach chair is identifiable at the distant right edge. A tiny dark/tan form at that chair may be a person but lacks sufficient human detail, so person remains unclear. I considered all 75 definitions; no other defined category has identifiable or plausibly unresolved evidence.

The crop shows a lighthouse, utility pole and wires, fence, building roof and leafy palms/shrubs. The lighthouse lantern is not a traffic signal or clock, and the outdoor vegetation has no identifiable growing pots. I explicitly considered all 75 definitions over the whole original crop and found no actual object meeting any of them. No unresolved category ambiguity.

A pizza slice with crust, melted cheese and round toppings sits on a flat dinner plate. A fork has clearly visible tines and handle above it, and the utensil below has a broad knife blade and handle. The surrounding wooden surface is identifiable as an eating table through this place setting. The flat plate is not a bowl, and the pizza toppings do not independently identify a hot dog or other defined food. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual horse carries a human acrobat, with many additional spectators visible. The stand contains identifiable individual blue molded seats/chairs rather than a continuous bench. Flowering foliage grows from visible low planter containers along the bottom, supporting potted plant; the surrounding shrubs alone do not add that category. Rails, signs and speaker boxes do not identify tables, televisions or other defined objects. I considered all 75 definitions over the original crop. No unresolved category ambiguity.

The bathroom vanity has identifiable washbasins and faucet assemblies on the countertop. The mirror reflects a dark human head/upper body holding a camera with a bright flash, supporting an actual person by reflection. The black mirror area is not a television; vanity cupboards are not a refrigerator or oven, and no toilet or identifiable toothbrush is visible. I considered all 75 definitions across the complete crop. No unresolved category ambiguity.

A man in a jacket, collared shirt and dark necktie stands beside an identifiable rail train at a curved station platform. The dark form beside his leg may be carried luggage, but its handle/body structure is too indistinct to distinguish a handbag from a small suitcase; both categories remain unclear. No backpack design is identifiable. The platform posts do not have identifiable traffic-signal heads. I considered every one of the 75 definitions; other categories have no supported presence.

An actual airborne jet has a clear fuselage, swept wings, engines and tail. At the extreme right are cropped bright fabric pieces and long multicolored streamers/lines; a kite is plausible but its body/string assembly is incompletely shown, so kite remains unclear. These fabric fragments do not identify actual birds. I considered all 75 definitions over the whole original crop; no other category has supported or unresolved evidence.

Several actual people stand at a dining table containing a large pizza, a tall necked bottle, stemmed wine glasses with bowls/stems/feet, straight drinking tumblers/pint glasses, and a large open white bowl at the right edge. The woman's scarf is not a necktie. Reflections and narrow table objects do not resolve into an identifiable fork, knife or spoon, and no other defined food is identifiable within the pizza. I considered every one of the 75 definitions across the whole original crop. No unresolved category ambiguity.
